pr_title: chore: support range requests in trace viewer http server
pr_comments: Is it feasible for us to write a test for this? Code looks fine but quite tricky.

issue_context.title: [BUG] cannot select playback time on html report video
comments: I was able to repro, reason for that is that our web-server does not support range requests.

review_comments: nit: I'd do something like `match = range.match(/^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/)` and use `+match[1], +match[2]`, but this also works.
`statusMessage` is set automatically, having it in the response body is also common practise afaik.
Let's comment that both "range header and createReadStream accept inclusive start/end".
There could be multiple ranges in the header, separated by commas. We should either  support it, or error out.
There could also be multiple dashes, like '1-5-10'. Let's error out in this case as well.
